items.workflow: BILL-05 — : Tax posture is honest by construction. Every zero-tax outcome we store or render carries Stripe’s `taxability_reason`, so "no tax owed" (`not_collecting`) is distinguishable from "calculated as zero" (`zero_rated`, `not_subject_to_tax`) — a bare `Tax: 0.00` is never presented as a calculation. The product tax category is set to a real code (never the untaxed default `txcd_00000000`) and the head-office address is configured, because `not_collecting` is ambiguous between "unregistered" and "product coded untaxed" and only those two settings disambiguate it. *(open: 28.1 is 11/11 in code; nothing has spoken to Stripe on a billing path (STATE 2026-08-29) and the tax country is unset pending the entity)*
